interpolation: tensor-product cubic in log10(T) and log10(Pgas), then linear in vacuum wavelength; logarithmic coefficients are interpolated before exponentiation

abundance_input_contract.file: input/Atoms/abundance.input at the pinned STiC commit
abundance_input_contract.mixture: Grevesse & Anders (1991)/Kurucz baseline with the file's selective historical Asplund overrides
abundance_input_contract.iron_annotation: Asplund et al. (2000), as recorded by STiC
abundance_input_contract.not_used: The separate Asplund, Amarsi & Grevesse (2021) reviewed abundance resource is not used by this production STiC lookup.

population_formulas.neutral_hydrogen_density: witt.gasc: n(H I) = [p(H I)/p(H')] p(H') / (k_B T); stored after cm^-3 to m^-3 conversion
population_formulas.fe_i_population_over_partition: witt.getXparts(atomic_number_minus_one=25, divide_by_u=False, return_u=True): n(Fe I)/U(Fe I); stored after cm^-3 to m^-3 conversion
population_formulas.line_lower_population: n_l = [n(Fe I)/U(Fe I)] (2 J_l + 1) exp[-E_l/(k_B T)], with reviewed line E_l and J_l

continuum_contract.runtime_fallback: none; missing or invalid STiC table is a hard error
continuum_contract.source_function_limitation: The current LTE formal solver applies B_lambda to total continuum extinction and does not iterate a coherent-scattering source. The tau500/geometric metric uses STiC total extinction, but upper-layer continuum intensities retain this explicit thermal-source approximation.
continuum_contract.thermodynamic_population_contract: Continuum coefficients, mass density, electron density, neutral atomic-H density, and n(Fe I)/U(Fe I) all come from the same converged pinned STiC/Wittmann (T, Pgas) state. Fe-I lower-level populations apply the LTE Boltzmann factor using reviewed line E_l and J_l at runtime.
continuum_contract.legacy_eos_scope: The separately packaged Barklem/Saha EOS remains available for atomic diagnostics and the inspectable H-minus-only continuum decomposition; production continuum, configured HSE, damping perturbers, and Fe-I line populations use this pinned STiC table.

falc_top_boundary.integration: STiC ceos::hydrostatic_cmass convention: tau[0]=m[0]*kappa[0]; subsequent tau increments use trapezoidal kappa500 over column mass
falc_top_boundary.tau500_extinction: true absorption plus scattering at vacuum 5000 Angstrom
